mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) increases CNS depression risk and may potentiate lorazepam's sedative effects while increasing fall risk and cardiac arrhythmia susceptibility.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, counsel patients on fall precautions, avoid dose escalation of lorazepam, and ensure adequate potassium/magnesium supplementation if needed.
